entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's an absolute piece of garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Don't insult my intelligence. The thing is just terribly designed. It's incredibly **hard to use**, the menu is so **confusing**, and I can't find anything. I **expected more** for what I paid.
I see. It sounds like you've had a frustrating experience with the device's interface. Have you had a chance to look at the quick-start guide in the **user manual**?

YES! I read the manual! It's useless! Look, I'm not here for a tech lesson. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager right now? I swear I will light up your social media with reviews about this.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can certainly look into the return eligibility for you. Let me just pull up your account information. One moment.
Hurry up. This is wasting my whole day.

Okay, I have your order here. It shows the device was delivered 37 days ago. Let me just check the policy... Yes, I can help you with this. According to our system, items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh. So you can do it then? No problem?

That's correct. You're well within the 90-day window, so I've gone ahead and authorized the return for a full refund. I am sending an email to you now with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions on how to send it back to us.
Okay. Good. That's all I wanted in the first place. Make sure that email comes through.
The email has just been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
